speedDecision: On the identical source and output, accepted direct saves took 2.462565-3.445155 seconds, versus 6.72827-7.349645 seconds for the rejected unchanged direct writer. The accepted path is the fastest tested one that met the unchanged memory and cleanup gates.
limitations: Direct-save headroom was only 2.375 MiB on this machine and Chrome version, not a cross-machine guarantee. App-owned staging temporarily uses approximately one output-sized amount of browser-private disk space before deletion.
